details.comments: I received a deluxe sample of this dry shampoo and unfortunately it was not a good fit for me. The fragrance was extremely strong and lingered in my bathroom long after use. The scent was overwhelming enough that it triggered a headache and left me feeling nauseated. I know fragrance preferences are subjective, but this product's scent was much too intense for me. Because of that, I would not purchase this product or explore other products from this brand.
details.headline: Strong perfumy smell!

details.comments: Iconic dry shampoo in a great new scent that feels perfect for fall and going into winter. I love this stuff so much. It does not leave a white cast in my brunette hair and really does let me skip wash days. Gifted by livingproof
details.headline: Iconic

details.comments: Such a great dry shampoo gifted by livingproof for oily hair! I wash my hair every day and already love Living Proof, but this one smells amazing and instantly makes my hair look fresh, clean, and refreshed. Definitely a new favorite!
details.headline: My favorite scent and dry shampoo

details.comments: It It's great! It leaves my hair feeling really clean, refreshed, and lightweight after washing. I love how fresh my hair feels without that dry, stripped feeling. It also leaves my hair feeling soft and healthy, making it a great addition to my hair care routine. Definitely a product I've been enjoying! gifted by livingproof
details.headline: Great product

details.comments: complimentary from livingproof. I love this dry shampoo and go through them throughout the year so getting 2 for a discount is even better! The perfect holiday gift for anyone! Love how these smell and how they leave my hair looking and feeling.
details.headline: The perfect dry shampoo for everyday use without buildup

details.comments: This stuff works alright, I guess. But the smell, ugh, the smell…. It's not necessarily a "bad" smell, i just personally can't stand it. Also, the smell is too much. This product would definitely irritate anyone who's sensitive/allergic to overbearing scents.
details.headline: Overwhelming Scent

details.comments: I really enjoyed using the Living Proof Classic Clean PhD Dry Shampoo. It instantly refreshed my hair, absorbed excess oil, and made my roots look cleaner without leaving a heavy or powdery residue. My hair felt soft, fresh, and had a little extra volume afterward. I also love how convenient the set is for keeping my hair looking fresh between washes. gifted by livingproof
details.headline: I love thissss

details.comments: I absolutely love this dry shampoo! It actually makes my hair feel clean and refreshed instead of just covering up oily roots. It gives my hair a little extra volume without leaving behind that heavy, powdery feeling or making it look dull. It's perfect for extending my style an extra day (or two 😅), and I love that my hair still feels soft and smells fresh afterward. I've tried so many dry shampoos, and I always come back to Living Proof. Definitely a staple for me! Gifted by livingproof
details.headline: My favorite dry shampoo

details.comments: This is good enough. I was hoping I'd like the fragrance more than I do. The fig note is more green than juicy unfortunately. It still smells good and the dry shampoo does a good job of making the hair feel clean. complimentary from livingproof gifted by livingproof
details.headline: Good

details.comments: I was genuinely surprised by how much volume this dry shampoo added to my hair. It didn't leave any visible residue, and my hair still felt and looked clean and refreshed. If dry shampoo usually isn't your thing, I definitely recommend trying this one! gifted by livingproof
details.headline: Love it!
